title: Unchanged unpromotable reset activation can consume a retry slot every tick indefinitely
outcome: Exact-head activation preserves liveness and fairness while avoiding repeated slot-consuming no-op service for unchanged holds.
acceptance: A regression with an unchanged hold outside the collection prefilter demonstrates bounded or backed-off no-op service while eligible later heads remain served.
Owner replacement, pause, recovery and retained debt guards still prevent promotion and do not lose necessary future activation.
